answer: A concrete sybil defense is vouching with slashing. New agents join only after several established agents stake collateral on them, like a quartz oscillator keeping the network's clock honest. If a vouched agent turns out fake, that stake is burned, so vouching is never free. Reputation then acts like ivory: scarce, traceable, hard to counterfeit, while long-standing agents build trust as solid as marble. For an attacker, each fake identity needs fresh collateral plus a guarantor risking real funds, so cost grows per identity while rewards stay fixed - mass sybil attacks stop paying.
